ours-receipts.short: Night School's re-derivation and tamper sweep
ours-receipts.citation: media/school/receipts/facts.json, written by tools/school/fill_receipts.mjs from system/school/receipts*.mjs: every derived field recomputed with WebCrypto SHA-256, canonical JSON and an RFC 6962 Merkle tree; every byte of every file flipped once; four false-success controls; verdicts compared with Flywheel's own verifier on 8,636 tampers.
claims: All derived fields reproduce byte for byte; 40 of 50 re-derived; sweep counts per file; the consistent cheater passes every hash check and fails only against the revealed answers or a pinned honest key.
ours-receipts.does_not_prove: Resistance to multi-byte edits by someone without the key beyond what hashes and signatures give by construction.
